artifact.name: S8-A same-seed paired topology-sequence fusion audit

question: What is the reproducible performance and seed variance of one Practical HGT plus one ModernBERT when the two branches use the same random seed?
descriptive_hybrid_reference: For each ModernBERT seed, also recompute the established three-HGT-plus-one-ModernBERT fusion under the identical folds and fitting protocol. This reference is descriptive and is not a hard gate for the lower-cost paired system.

component_branches.graph: reuse the official P4 single_platt_seedXXXX_oof_score and prediction
component_branches.sequence: reuse each official S1 ModernBERT modernbert_oof_score and prediction
component_branches.note: Branch scores are used only as frozen comparison operating points; paired fusion is fit from the two raw logit margins.

statistics.hierarchical_scheme: sample three seeds with replacement and independently sample all source-clone components with replacement; calculate mean paired-system F1 minus the corresponding mean branch/hybrid F1
statistics.point_summary: arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation across the three same-seed systems

interpretation.primary_paper_result_if_frozen_later: three one-HGT-plus-one-ModernBERT paired systems reported as mean plus or minus sample standard deviation
interpretation.not_nine_runs: cross-seed combinations are not treated as independent experiments
interpretation.not_final_test: validation has informed prior development and this audit; only a later one-time locked test is independent confirmation
